Savant Capital Has Trimmed Jpmorgan Chase & Co (JPM) Holding by $446,028 as Share Value Declined; Global Endowment Management LP Increases Holding in Disney Walt Co (DIS)
June 10, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Global Endowment Management Lp increased its stake in Disney Walt Co (DIS) by 32.79% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Global Endowment Management Lp bought 10,500 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.93% with the market. The institutional investor held 42,520 shares of the television services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.27M, up from 32,020 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Global Endowment Management Lp who had been investing in Disney Walt Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $154.98 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.47% or $1.51 during the last trading session, reaching $103.98. About 7.09 million shares traded. The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) has declined 4.73% since June 10, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.30% the S&P500.
